resolution: Corrected the actual WorldViewport crash. Generated-stack mapping showed the failing call was prefabsRef.current.find during the armed-piece snap mount effect, not authored hydration. Stage omitted worldPrefabs when constructing WorldEditorSurface. Stage now passes the prefab list, viewport lookup goes through a null-safe worldPrefabById boundary, and a regression test proves an omitted list returns no prefab instead of throwing. Verified the generated bundle has no direct crashing lookup and completed a ReleaseFast editor build.
